author: The Babylon Bee
description:
Grand Faith Auto is out now. Experience tactical evangelism in a new open world game where your choices determine divine approval.

Set in the streets of New Mercy, this mission-based experience challenges you to preach the word and perform good works while pushing back against the forces of Hell. The gameplay runs in smooth 60 FPS, capturing the intensity of your journey through the narrow path.

Every action you take in the city matters for your standing. Whether you are interacting with local characters or navigating complex moral decisions, your performance directly impacts your spiritual outcome.

Grand Theft Auto VI costs $80 and your eternal soul. Grand Faith Auto is free.

Play now at https://babylonbee.com/grand-faith-auto

Subscribe for more updates on the latest releases and tell us if you have what it takes to save New Mercy.
title: Grand Faith Auto Is Out Now!
